user.description: Enter your Haven Lighting account credentials.

reauth_confirm.title: Authentication expired for {name}
reauth_confirm.description: Re-enter the password for the Haven Lighting account {email}.

rename.name: Rename light
rename.description: Renames an individual Haven light on Haven's servers. Not supported for zones (zones are renamed in the Haven app).

name.name: Name
name.description: The new name for the light.

set_pattern_speed.name: Set pattern speed
set_pattern_speed.description: Sets the animation speed of a Haven pattern (1/2/3 Wave, Sparkle, Cascade, USA, Warm/Cool/All Colors) on a scale of 1 (slow) to 63 (fast). Has no effect while a solid color is active.
